default.notes: Apply online at evisa.gov.ss before travel (about USD 100 for a single-entry tourist visa) or through a South Sudanese embassy — every nationality needs a visa.

groups.notes: South Sudan belongs to the East African Community, but free movement is not yet implemented — EAC citizens still need a visa, though fees are waived or reduced for some nationalities under bilateral arrangements; confirm on evisa.gov.ss before travel.

SS.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for South Sudanese citizens.
